name: Britannia bourbon (3)
ingredients_raw: Refined Wheat Flour (maida), sugar(33%), Refined Palm Oil, edible Maize Starch, colors ( 150a,150d, 122,110,133 & 102), Cocoa Solids(2.7%), milk Solids, raising Agents [500(ii)& [503(ii)], Nature Identical & Artificial (vanilla, chocolate Milk & Milky Cocoa) Flavouring Substances, Emulsifiers [471 & 322(i)] And Iodised Salt.
